title: Report: GameSpot Reports GTA 6 Gym Trick Lets Jason and Lucia Train Together to Save Time
description: GameSpot reports that Grand Theft Auto 6 players can cut gym workout time by exercising Jason and Lucia as a pair, with both protagonists gaining muscle simultaneously. The finding is presented as a player discovery, not an official Rockstar announcement.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Gym Trick Trains Jason and Lucia Together to Save Time
socialHook: GameSpot reports that working out Jason and Lucia together in GTA 6 lets both protagonists gain muscle at once, cutting gym time in half.

sections.heading: What GameSpot Reported
paragraphs: GameSpot reported that Grand Theft Auto 6 players can cut gym workout time by training Jason and Lucia together. According to the publication, both protagonists gain muscle and tone up simultaneously when exercising as a pair, effectively reducing the time needed to bulk up. The report also notes that workouts can be tracked through a smartphone app, that an optimal training time exists, and that players can use either a proper gym or the weights outside Jason’s house. GameSpot framed the finding as something players are discovering after launch, not as an official Rockstar announcement.

sections.heading: What Remains Unknown
paragraphs: GameSpot did not specify the exact controller inputs required, the complete list of gym locations, or whether Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive have officially verified the mechanic. The publication presented the method as a player discovery rather than confirmed developer guidance. Readers should treat the time-saving claim as an unverified report attributed to GameSpot, distinct from any Rockstar statement.
